historical_evidence.note: Estimator and temperature-era ablations remain historical records and include an explicit mapping to the current API.

known_boundaries: Backward remains dense O(T^2); candidate pruning is prohibited in the default training operator.
The VJP is a useful dense surrogate, not the mathematical derivative of exact hard routing.
The normalized-square-root route score is a fixed surrogate utility; its monotonicity preserves evidence ordering only inside backward and does not define hard routing.
Dropout changes backward exploration only; it cannot make the hard forward differentiable.
No matched fitting cell exceeded 7/8; the synthetic matrix is not evidence of universal pretraining benefit.
The static scale and mismatch_scale defaults are empirical and are not universally optimal.
A high mismatch_scale can suppress discovery of long near matches; scale cannot restore vanished suffix products.
FP16 can underflow long-tail route gradients; use loss scaling or FP32 projections when full support matters.
CUDA atomic accumulation is numerically reproducible within tolerance, not bitwise deterministic.
The cancellation-resistant diagonal VJP is numerically stable, but the tested CUDA factorization is slower and uses O(BHT^2) scratch; production remains row-owned.
The global-bit oracle is exponential and restricted to B=H=1 tiny cases; its bit temperature defines a stochastic research objective, not a production route temperature.

Global-bit enumeration shares each activation bit across all of its uses but does not model correlations induced by shared Q/K projection parameters; exact zero logits remain Bernoulli(0.5) rather than the production -1 symbol.
No new estimator has cleared the shared-parameter, contextual-recall, and matched-cost gates; the new CUDA work changes execution factorization only, not the estimator.
The stateful grammar uses fixed phase and outline scaffolds; raw-residual grammar discovery is untested.
Conflict-driven dormant-bit splits consume continuation labels and are not evidence of unsupervised symbol emergence.
Frozen dormant-bit growth has not been tested while an unrelated language-modeling loss remains active.
The pretraining codebook diagnostic consumes collected Q/K occurrences and labels; it is not evidence that a full model can discover or preserve those trajectories during pretraining.
The archived exact hard diagonal index had no safe input-independent auto selector because its benefit depended on hard-code match density; it is absent from the frozen build.
Archived research CUDA measurements are retained for auditability, but their raw operators and dedicated build-path tests are absent from the frozen package.
Full-model pretraining at realistic depth and context has not yet been completed.
